title_sq: Okazion Kleringu! Prane Rruges Se Elbasanit, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Ne Faze Perfundimtare !
description_sq: Okazion Kleringu! Prane Rruges Se Elbasanit, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Ne Faze Perfundimtare !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe bruto 127.4 m2 ndodhet ne katin e 1 te njeres prej godinave te kompleksit. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit , 2 dhoma gjumi njera me tualet te dedikuar dhe me dalje ne ballkon dhe nje tjeter tualet me dritare . Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Veri-Lindje, cka i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites. Kompleksi Xheluks dallohet per punimet cilesore, duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike inkaso, instalimet e sistemit te kondicionimit multisplit, shtrimi me parket ose me pllake, dritare dopioxham termike etj. Apartamenti eshte ne faze perfundimtare dhe behet shume shpejt gati per banim.
title_en: Clearing opportunity! Near Elbasan Street, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, in the final phase!
description_en: Clearing opportunity! Near Elbasan Street, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, in the final phase!! The apartment with a gross area of ​​127.4 m2 is located on the 1st floor of one of the buildings of the complex. The apartment is organized in the living room together with the kitchen corner, 2 single bedrooms with a dedicated toilet and exit to the balcony and another toilet with a window. The orientation of the apartment is North-East, which allows natural light throughout the day. The Xeluks complex stands out for its quality works, starting from inkaso plumbing installations, multisplit air conditioning system installations, flooring with parquet or tiles, thermal double-glazed windows, etc. The apartment is in the final stage and will be ready for occupancy very soon.
